I farm this wheat plot the way I have done before. Last season I shared a small amount of urea with my neighbor, and I will do the same this year because the cooperative only sells big bags that I cannot afford alone for this small rented piece. I will use the seed I kept from my own harvest last year, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves because hiring labor costs cash I do not have.
